title: feat(types)!: retire sixteen NamedListView members as `?: never` tombstones (objectui#7924)
body:
Part of #7924

Clause-②: yes (the declared surface grows by two protocol blocks, then narrows by eighteen tombstones; an isolated at-tier contract review happens before enqueue)

> The Clause line above is copied verbatim from the claim. Two of its figures did not survive re-measurement, see "What moved from the dispatch" below: the surface does not grow (both blocks were already declared), and it narrows by **sixteen**, not eighteen.

Executes buckets ② A and ③ of the director-seat ruling on objectui#7924 (issuecomment-5690906005). This PR does not do bucket ① (having the `object-view` delegation read the 23 protocol-declared members off the named view), so the card stays open.

## What changed

- `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`, `NamedListView`: **sixteen `?: never` tombstones**. Each docblock carries `@deprecated RETIRED (objectui#7924)` and names the key to write instead.
  - Bucket ② has eight legacy spellings. `showSearch`, `showSort`, `showFilters`, `showHideFields`, `showGroup`, `showColor` and `showDensity` point at `userActions.search`, `.sort`, `.filter`, `.hideFields`, `.group`, `.rowColor` and `.rowHeight`. `showDescription` points at `appearance.showDescription`.
  - Bucket ③ has eight members the protocol declares nowhere and no renderer acts on: `addDeleteRecordsInline`, `addRecordViaForm`, `clickIntoRecordDetails`, `collapseAllByDefault`, `color`, `fieldTextColor`, `prefixField`, `wrapHeaders`.
- ⛔ The runtime fold in `packages/core/src/utils/normalize-list-view.ts` is **untouched**. Stored documents keep parsing and keep being folded. Only the authoring face changed.
- ⛔ No alias mapping was added anywhere.
- Census pin `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts`:
  - The AST walker now also reports the tombstone set (a member whose type node is the `never` keyword) and each member's docblock.
  - A new describe block pins the tombstone set by name. It asserts that the set is exactly bucket ② plus bucket ③ minus the two retained members, and that no tombstone is a protocol key or read off a named view.
  - Each bucket-② docblock names its canonical `block.key`.
  - Type-level: a pin that every tombstone resolves to `undefined`, plus sixteen `@ts-expect-error` literals, one for each tombstone.
  - Protocol-shaped `userActions` / `appearance` values are accepted on a literal and also parse against the protocol's own `ObjectListViewSchema` slots. A legacy spelling as control does not parse.
  - The two retained reads are pinned by source text, with a firing control.
  - The bucket-③ gloss "no runtime fold, and no reader on any path" is corrected. Its membership is unchanged.
- `p1-spec-alignment.test.ts`: the only TS authoring site of the retired keys in the repo. It is migrated to `userActions` / `rowColor`.
- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx`: the `NamedListView` row now says where the toggles live.
- `.changeset/7924-named-list-view-retire.md`: `minor` on `@object-ui/types`, with the **BREAKING** banner and the ADR-0087 disposition line. ⛔ Not `major`.

## What moved from the dispatch (reported, not smoothed)

1. **Step 1 is a no-op.** `NamedListView` already declares `userActions?: ListViewSchema['userActions']` and `appearance?: ListViewSchema['appearance']`. They are spec-derived by indexed access and landed with objectui#8980. Nothing was added.
2. **Two bucket-③ members are read, so they are NOT tombstoned.** Per the dispatch, work stopped on these two:
   - `allowExport` has this relay line in app-shell's object page: `allowExport: viewDef.allowExport ?? listSchema.allowExport,`. There, `viewDef` is the active view resolved from `objectDef.listViews`, which app-shell's own `ViewConfigPanel` / `view-config-adapter` headers call a flat `NamedListView`. `ListView` then gates export on `schema.allowExport !== false &&`.
   - `densityMode` is relayed the same way (`densityMode: viewDef.densityMode ?? listSchema.densityMode,`). `normalizeListViewSchema` then folds it onto top-level `rowHeight` (`const legacyDensity = s.densityMode;`). So it is a legacy spelling with a runtime fold, the bucket-② shape. Its canonical key is top-level `rowHeight`, ⛔ not `userActions.rowHeight`, which is a boolean toolbar toggle.
   - Control for these two: app-shell relays `prefixField` in exactly the same way, and nothing downstream reads it. `ListView` has zero `prefixField` hits against non-zero `allowExport` hits on the same query. That difference is why `prefixField` was tombstoned.
3. **Tombstone pointers.** The ruling allowed `color` to point at `userActions.rowColor`. It points at the top-level `rowColor: { field }` configuration instead, and warns off `userActions.rowColor`. The reason: `color` names a FIELD, and `userActions.rowColor` is a boolean panel toggle. App-shell's own relay comment draws the same line. `addRecordViaForm` points at the protocol's `userActions.addRecordForm` ("Add records through a form instead of inline"). Both are text only.

## Figures, and the instrument for each

- Declared members: 64, required `label` only. Measured by a TypeScript AST walk: the census pin, plus a language-service script over the root tsconfig. The count does not move, because a tombstone is still a declared member. That is what makes the refusal work by name.
- Typed authoring and read sites of the eighteen: a language-service `findReferences` on each member's declaration, over the 4858 files in the root tsconfig. It found hits in one file only, `p1-spec-alignment.test.ts`, for `showSearch` / `showSort` / `showFilters` / `color`. Control: `columns` returned 6 references in plugin-view.
- Untyped reads (through `any`): an AST name scan over `packages/*/src`, `apps` and `examples` (4799 files). It covered property access, element access, object-literal keys, destructuring and declarations. Absent control `zzqNoSuch` returned 0. This scan found the `app-shell` relay and the two live downstream reads.

## Consumer fixes

**None needed.** After rebuilding the closure, `tsc` on plugin-view, app-shell, plugin-dashboard and plugin-grid (the four packages that type against `ObjectViewSchema` / `NamedListView`) is green with zero edits. That matches the `findReferences` reading. The Studio literal carrying `addDeleteRecordsInline: true` is a `list-view` schema cast `as never`, not a `NamedListView`, and is untouched. Legacy stored data read through loose types (`activeView?.showSearch` in app-shell) is untouched by design.

## Verification, at `360a4fc9a` (after merging `origin/main` `06b82b8c3`)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check`: all three `tsc` invocations echoed, including `tsconfig.test.json`, exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/`: `Test Files 214 passed (214)`, `Tests 4941 passed (4941)`.
- Consumer closure: `turbo run build --concurrency=2` with the four `^...` filters gave `28 successful, 28 total`. The rebuilt `dist/objectql.d.ts` carries `showSearch?: never;`. Then `type-check` on the four consumers: all four `Done`, exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the three changed TS files: 3 files, 0 errors, 34 warnings. The warnings are pre-existing `no-explicit-any`, and `origin/main`'s `objectql.ts` reads the same 34. `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot move a verdict on any untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- `check-changeset-presence` 0, `check-changeset-no-major` 0, `check:spec-symbols` 0, `check:new-line-citations` 0 (0 new citations), `check:control-bytes` 0, and `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the five paths reports NOT GOVERNED.
- **Reverse verification**, run after the fix was committed. `showSearch?: never;` was replaced by `showSearch?: boolean;` through `ablation-replace.mjs`. Proof it landed: anchor count went 1 to 0, and blob `f836ad51` became `b310c292`.
  - Result: `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exited 2 with exactly two errors. One is TS2344 on the every-tombstone-is-`undefined` pin. The other is TS2578, an unused `@ts-expect-error`, on the `showSearch` refusal literal.
  - Vitest on the census went `2 failed | 227 passed`. The two failures are the tombstone-set pin and the `showSearch` canonical-key pin.
  - Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`. The blob is back to `f836ad51` = HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

Not run locally, declared to CI: the full `pnpm test`, the repo-wide `pnpm lint`, and vitest for the consumer packages. No runtime file changed, so their runtime tests measure nothing this PR moved.

## Acceptance notes

- The census's "unread" is scoped to the `object-view` renderer's reads off `schema.listViews`. App-shell's object page also holds a named view, as its active view, and relays many bucket-① members off it into `list-view`. Anyone doing bucket ① should re-measure against both hosts, not only plugin-view.
- `userActions.editInline` sits beside `addRecordForm` in the protocol. Nothing here maps `addDeleteRecordsInline` to it, because the semantics differ (inline editing, as opposed to inline add and delete).
